title: genoa Capability Declaration v1
description: Schema for a single agent capability declaration. Extends the MCP tool/list tool object shape (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-05/server/tools) with a required 'provenance' field and optional 'trust' field. The core 'name', 'description', and 'inputSchema' fields are MCP-compatible — a genoa capability SHOULD be invocable via the MCP tools/call method if the runtime is 'mcp-server'.

name.description: Tool/capability name. MUST be unique within the image's capability list. MCP-compatible: used as the tool name in tools/call.

description.description: Human and LM-readable description of what this capability does and its contract. MCP-compatible: used by LMs for tool selection.
examples: Execute a shell command on the host and return stdout/stderr. Restricted to /bin and /usr/bin by SELinux policy.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema (Draft 7 for MCP compatibility) describing the tool's input parameters. MCP-compatible: passed verbatim to the LM for parameter planning.

provenance.description: Provenance declaration for this capability. Agents use this to decide how much to trust the capability. This field is the genoa extension — not present in MCP spec.

source.description: Origin of this capability. 'built-in' means shipped with the base image. 'installed' means added post-build. 'plugin' means loaded from a plugin bundle.

trust.description: Trust level declaration. 'attested' = covered by image attestation. 'signed' = has package signature but not in attestation. 'unverified' = no cryptographic claim. Agents MUST surface 'unverified' to end users before invocation.

package_id.description: Package identifier in the image's SPDX SBOM (SPDXID). Enables cross-referencing capability to SBOM entry.

attestation_ref.description: Index or URI reference to the capability_claim entry in the image's attestation document.

added_at.description: Timestamp when this capability was added. For 'built-in', equals image build_timestamp.

added_by.description: Actor that added this capability. For 'built-in', the build pipeline identity. For 'installed', the actor who ran the installer.

annotations.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for this capability. Follows OCI annotation key naming convention (reverse-DNS).

deprecated.description: If true, this capability is deprecated. LMs SHOULD prefer alternatives.

alternatives.description: Names of alternative capabilities to use instead. Populated when deprecated=true.

examples.name: execute_shell_command
examples.description: Execute a shell command on the host and return stdout/stderr. Restricted to /bin and /usr/bin by pledge policy.
